workflow.validate: npm run build && npm test && node --check public/app.js
workflow.authentication: Use an already authorized Wrangler session or a narrowly scoped Cloudflare Pages deployment token. Never commit a credential.
workflow.ci: The GitHub workflow validates and uploads the static Pages artifact; production publication is explicit.

boundaries.localOnlyQA: test/responsive-preview.html is served only by the local preview server and is excluded from dist.

maintenance: Review changes to the source install guides and update sourceCommit in content.mjs when adopting a newer reviewed baseline.
Refresh public production installer snapshots only after reviewing their trust model, permission manifest, and callback behavior.
Run all checks and desktop/mobile browser QA before publishing.
Verify the custom-domain HTTPS response, security headers, download hashes, and actual rendered page after deployment.
Do not replace customer-specific connector values with values from screenshots or invent a new workload identity because the portal is hosted on Cloudflare.
